selection.objective: Minimize equal-family mean absolute gain difference from the capped -18 LUFS-M Max reference, averaging Max and P95.
selection.selection_scope: Measured starting point on local rendered stereo sound effects; not a universal LUFS-to-sones conversion or a listening-panel validation.

tools.decoder: FFmpeg; all source files are 48 kHz stereo, no rate conversion was needed.
